description: This file contains a PHPUnit test class for the ProjectActivityDetailedReportAPI in the OrangeHRM Time plugin. It tests the API's 'getOne' method with data providers and verifies that delete, update, and their validation rules are not implemented. The class extends EndpointIntegrationTestCase and uses mock services for testing.

classes.name: ProjectActivityDetailedReportAPITest
classes.description: Test class for the ProjectActivityDetailedReport API, focusing on 'getOne' functionality and ensuring other methods are marked as not implemented.

methods.name: testGetOne
methods.description: Tests the 'getOne' API method with various test cases provided by data provider.

methods.name: dataProviderForTestGetOne
methods.description: Provides test case data for 'testGetOne' from a YAML fixture.

methods.name: testDelete
methods.description: Confirms that calling 'delete' on the API throws a not implemented exception.

methods.name: testUpdate
methods.description: Confirms that 'update' method is not implemented.
